full_judgment: 12. Mr. Wahhab Mia next referred to another decision in the case of Abdul Hakim and others Vs. The State reported in 7 BCR (AD) 143. It has been observed by their Lordships in that case that for the purpose of considering the prayer for bail the direct and overt act alleged against the persons named in the F.I.R. are required to be considered. Mr. Wahhab Mia said that in the instant case before us there is nothing to show that the accused-petitioner had any direct overt act of the alleged occurrence of murder and as such, he is entitled to get bail. We have already discussed the facts and circumstances and the manner of murder of 3 persons at a time of this case and have found that there are sufficient materials available disclosing a prima facie case for believing that the accused-petitioner had direct complicity in the commission of the offence of this tripple murder.
